name: adversarial-audit
description: Audit correctness, performance, tests, and operational contracts, then verify fixes when remediation is authorized.

interface.longDescription: An evidence-driven audit workflow with explicit assessment and remediation modes, ranked findings, a live evidence ledger, and verification matched to the system and available capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Audit this system for concrete correctness, performance, and contract risks without changing source.
Audit and fix the accepted in-scope defects, with fresh evidence for each remediation.
